title: Mandanes
summary: Raleigh names Mandanes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Mandanes, in the Median lists of Annius and of Diodorus, who raigned fiftie yeeres after Arbaces. The same name and the same length were left as one man. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. IV, sig. 353a
